spec.assertion: No TriggerDef kind expresses an incoming-attack counter, and the scope-lock boss deals no damage, so the trigger is unreachable. it.skip documents the gap; the live test asserts the ACTIVE branch never occurs.

Asserts ZERO buffApply with stat atkPct value 26.66 anywhere in the run. Fails under the nearest-wrong that proxies 'when attacked' with hitCount / shotFired / interval, all of which would fire repeatedly and over-credit maiden's ATK for most of the fight.
it.skip — aggro redirection has no effect primitive and no damage-side payload against an immortal, non-attacking boss. Belongs verbatim in the override's `unmodeled.skill2`.

buffApply exists with stat critDamagePct value 152.84. Fails under the nearest-wrong stat mis-encoding (critRatePct at the same magnitude, explicitly asserted absent) and under a scoped/normal-only variant.

Every critDamagePct@152.84 apply has targetSlug === 'maiden', and both counterfactual runs leave every teammate total byte-identical. Fails under target 'allies' / 'alliesOfWeapon', which would hand 152.84% crit damage to the whole team.

Every apply carries a finite expiresFrame, AND stripping durationSec strictly RAISES maiden's total. Fails under a passive/permanent encoding (base would already equal the permanent run) — the classic over-credit for a windowed self buff.

⛑ NOT asserted. The kit prose gives no activation clause for this buff, so its period is outside the input domain (an ALWAYS-⛑ field). Guessing an interval here would be invention; the test deliberately asserts scope/stat/magnitude/boundedness only.
Zeroing every burst-slot flatDamage strictly lowers maiden's total (the line is live and non-vacuous), and teammates stay byte-identical (enemy-facing damage, not an ally grant).

Every srcSlot==='burst' damage event has fbMajorApplied === false and inFullBurst === false. Fails under the nearest-wrong that keys the nuke to fullBurstEnter, which would stamp the +50% Full Burst major on a hit that lands before the window opens.

THE payload assertion. Attribution-free identity: (base - burstZero) === (burstDup - base), where burstDup adds exactly one duplicate of the first burst flatDamage. Holds at 1 hit/cast; FAILS 2:1 under the nearest-wrong where the Revenge rider fires unconditionally — a silent 2x on maiden's entire burst line.

No buffApply targeting maiden carries pelletCountFlat / normalAttackPct / maxAmmoFlat / maxAmmoPct. Her kit has no weapon-state line, so any such buff on an SG with hitsPerShot 10 would be fit-to-number, not a modeled mechanic.

fixtures: controlComp('maiden', false) — liter B1 + crown B2 + maiden B3 (carry, focus), deterministic, no seed. The fixed extra B3 slot is dropped on purpose: it emits its OWN burst-slot damage events (confounding the srcSlot==='burst' FB-exemption filter) and carries crit-side ally buffs that muddy the Critical Damage reading. B1+B2 are retained so the chain actually completes — maiden is a lone Burst III and would make ZERO full bursts without them. 5 hoisted runs: base, CRIT_PERMANENT (durationSec stripped), CRIT_ZERO (value 0), BURST_ZERO (all burst flatDamage atkPct 0), BURST_DUP (one extra copy of the first burst flatDamage). All magnitude claims are base-vs-counterfactual deltas on totals(res)['maiden'], so no event-level slug attribution is required; buff claims attribute directly via buffApply.targetSlug.
gaps: it.skip 'ACTIVE branch of the Revenge gate is unreachable — GAP, no primitive': TriggerDef has no incoming-attack / damage-taken kind, and the scope-lock boss deals no damage to units, so neither skill1's Revenge ATK buff nor the burst's Revenge-gated 457.87% rider can EVER be exercised in the active case. Modeling it would need a new trigger primitive plus a boss-damage model — both out of scope. The inactive case IS asserted (rider silent, no 26.66 atkPct buff).

it.skip 'skill2 Taunt (10s, all enemies) — UNMODELED, no primitive': no effect kind expresses aggro redirection, and with an immortal boss that deals no damage it carries no damage-side payload. Should appear verbatim in the override's `unmodeled.skill2`, not as a block.

NOT-ASSERTED (⛑, outside the input domain): the trigger cadence of skill2's Critical Damage buff. The kit prose gives no activation clause, so the period is unknowable blind; the test asserts stat identity, magnitude, self-scope, time-boundedness and damage relevance, but deliberately nothing about when or how often it fires.

NOT-ASSERTED (⛑): maiden's SG cadence tuple / pellet-landing fraction (hitsPerShot 10, ammo 9, reloadFrames 142) — datamine-unreliable fields, no kit line touches them; only the inertness check that the override invents no compensating pellet/ammo buff.
